coordinatorSummary: CONSENT at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with no advisories. Fourteen attacks run, none landed. Custody is clean and the MF-6 is unapplied: 2bdb995b at 0444 unmoved, HEAD never left 6b5f4c8, file 08 still at 23 gate rows with no DR-G24, COORD at its pin, all five file pins plus the D-149 commit pin reproducing, and D-149 verified adopted with a single heading. The mechanics match the standard this family set at D-147. The condition-4 cell quoted for replacement is byte-exact against live file 08 and occurs exactly once in the whole file; both operands are fenced with no backslash bytes and no edge whitespace. The new row carries eight fields in the live header's order with status OPEN, and its harness cell is built like the DR-G23 row D-147 added, down to the not-authored and not-QUALIFIED hedges and the parenthetical naming of the owning classes. Every count reconciles against a table I counted myself: 23 gate rows today at 20 OPEN and 3 HARD-BLOCKED, so 21 and 3 after the insert; owners 23 of 23 to 24 of 24; required gates 19 of 19 to 20 of 20 with D-150 added to the attribution list. A character-by-character diff of the operands shows exactly those five changes and nothing else. The insertion anchor is real, DR-G24 is a free identifier, and the naming happens in the same act, which closes the condition-4 flip I raised as CLAUDE-PONAL-V1-ADV1 — an advisory the entry cites by name. Fidelity to the recorded artifact holds: the owner string and the NT-1/NT-2 ownership match exactly, and the row's claim is the first sentence of the artifact's proposed claim with the corpus half moved into the harness column, which is where corpus text lives in this table — I compared the DR-G23 row to confirm that convention rather than reading it as truncation. Two things I checked because they were defects earlier in this sequence and are not defects here: the entry never treats CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED as a Class A bar — measured, the string does not occur at all — and its eligibility statement gives the correct reason, that gates 2 and 3 fail because five leftover classes remain, with gate 4 reserving the determination to a later dedicated cycle. Scope is honest throughout: closure is claimed only for NT-1 and NT-2, NT-3, NT-5, NT-6, NT-7 and NT-8 are listed as still leftover, NT-4 stays discharged and unnamed here, and performing one of D-149's five kinds is stated to be this cycle's choice rather than a mandate.
